headline: Jakmania Celebrate Persija 98th Anniversary At Bundaran HI Jakarta
seoTitle: Jakmania Celebrate Persija 98th Anniversary At Bundaran HI
metaDescription: Thousands of The Jakmania supporters gathered at Bundaran HI to mark Persija Jakarta's 98th anniversary, causing significant traffic and transit delays.
aiSummaryBullets: The Jakmania supporters gathered at Bundaran HI on November 27 to celebrate the 98th anniversary of the Persija Jakarta football club.
The large crowd caused heavy traffic congestion in the area, leading authorities to implement traffic management adjustments.
Transjakarta bus passengers reported being trapped in the crowd and traffic for several hours from late night until early morning.
aiContextParagraph: The event marked the 98th anniversary of the Persija Jakarta football club, drawing thousands of supporters, known as The Jakmania, to the Bundaran HI area in Jakarta. The celebration, which occurred on November 27, 2026, involved significant activity including the use of flares that illuminated the surroundings. The influx of supporters into the central district resulted in major traffic disruptions throughout the vicinity. Commuters using public transportation, specifically Transjakarta bus services, experienced extensive delays, with some passengers reporting being stranded within the congestion from late at night until the early hours of the following morning. Local authorities responded by implementing traffic management strategies to address the resulting gridlock in the area. The gathering follows a series of previous public events reported in the capital city, though this specific occurrence was centered on the sports club's milestone anniversary.
whyItIsViral: The story is trending due to widespread media coverage from five independent outlets reporting on the significant traffic disruptions and impact on public transit.
